description: David Banner's gamma experiment creates the Hulk and forces him onto the road, where each attempt to help strangers risks exposing him to reporter Jack McGee and destroying another temporary life.

s01e01-02.description: Scientist David Banner's attempt to unlock hidden human strength with gamma radiation creates the Hulk and turns his life into a fugitive search for a cure.

s01e03-04.description: David takes work near a wealthy young woman who cannot walk and uncovers a plot by her stepmother and doctor to kill her for an inheritance.

s01e05.description: David befriends an aspiring boxer and becomes his corner man, then discovers the young fighter is being exploited as an unwitting drug courier.

s01e06.description: David joins a zoo research project studying animal aggression and investigates a mysterious illness killing animals under the facility's care.

s01e07.description: The Hulk is blamed for a model's murder, sending David undercover as a valet to reconstruct conflicting accounts of what really happened.

s01e08.description: Working at a Times Square arcade, David becomes caught between a family-run business and the protection racket threatening to destroy it.

s01e09.description: A flight carrying an Egyptian exhibit becomes the scene of a theft scheme, leaving David to save the aircraft when its crew is incapacitated.

s01e10.description: David helps an injured reporter expose a Las Vegas criminal operation while Jack McGee closes in on the evidence and the Hulk.

s01e11.description: David joins a young woman trying to recover her father's stolen truck from hijackers, turning a highway chase into another Hulk-sized confrontation.

s01e12.description: A medical experiment that might help David instead leads him to a pregnant woman and a doctor running an illegal baby-selling operation.

s01e13.description: David infiltrates a nuclear plant to access gamma equipment just as an earthquake cripples the facility and threatens a wider disaster.

s01e14.description: Working in a waterfront tavern, David helps a young widow resist corrupt union enforcers trying to seize control of her business.
